info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Compute Engine API (v1) discovery document. Every other official method returns HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Networks, subnetworks, firewall rules, routes, disks, snapshots and instance templates are configuration metadata: no packet is routed or filtered, no VM runs and no block storage exists. Only custom mode VPC networks are accepted (autoCreateSubnetworks=false); no default computeNetwork, default internet route or subnet route is created, and Network.subnetworks and peerings are not maintained. Disks and snapshots hold no data: sizes are recorded as given (blank disks default to 500 GB), a disk created from a source must state sizeGb, snapshots report storageBytes 0 and do not copy the source size, and customer-supplied encryption keys are refused. Instances are not simulated: instances.insert and every other instance method return UNIMPLEMENTED, because inserting an instance boots a VM; instance templates store the configuration only. References must name existing resources of this project; a network still used by a computeSubnetwork, firewall rule, route or instance template cannot be deleted, and subnetwork ranges may not overlap within a network. Operations complete synchronously with status DONE and remain readable through zoneOperations, regionOperations and globalOperations get, list and wait.
